contracts.detail: Srgb/Srgba are unbounded float encoded leaves, not finite/range admission. RGB transfer may overflow and alpha is copied. SurfaceMaterial::is_finite checks source scalars, explicitly not decoded factors; ValidatedMetal remains recipe policy.

Mandatory Inherit/Surface/Textile owns one payload. material() derives current textile appearance; textile_mut exposes that same authoritative payload. Default and gilt trim consumers use the typed appearance. Physical textile chart/seam/UV policy is not cleared.

Bevy receives encoded RGB via Color::srgba; GLB/review projection decodes RGB, copies alpha and checks resulting finite factors. No implied [0,1] or complete GLB geometry/size admission. Float UI uses linear egui RGB and converts back only on change; old chainmail byte picker is not misrepresented as arbitrary-precision UI.

findings.claim: A kernel uniform ring must not wrap within a batch; piece and morphs may exceed it.
findings.mismatch: Pinned canonical KernelBatch owns a UniformArena. allocate appends a new chunk when the current chunk is full and retains all chunks; it does not wrap and overwrite earlier dispatch slots. The explanation preserves an obsolete reason for one submission per realization.
findings.remedy: Keep batching behavior unchanged. Replace the two-line rationale with “Record and submit each realization separately.”, or remove it; do not substitute an unmeasured capacity/performance assurance.
findings.ownership: Connected Creator documentation; coordinate with #780/Root receiving owner. No source changed.
findings.acceptance: Current wording no longer asserts a wrapping uniform ring or fixed dispatch capacity, with batch behavior and all existing fixtures unchanged.

findings.claim: glTF takes a texture’s colour as the whole base colour.
findings.mismatch: The current exporter explicitly preserves a scalar baseColorFactor and sets it to white when a base-color map is present. The whole-color outcome here depends on that explicit white-factor projection, rather than a protocol rule that the texture replaces the factor.
findings.remedy: “The largest atlas level tinted in sRGB, with coverage as alpha. The hair shell uses a white scalar factor so the texture supplies its color and opacity.” Keep tinting/coverage/packing code unchanged.
findings.ownership: Connected Creator hair-export documentation, coordinated receiving repair; no source changed.
findings.acceptance: Explain the actual white-factor/map relationship without saying that the protocol discards a nonwhite scalar factor.
